title: FiTv2: Scalable and Improved Flexible Vision Transformer for Diffusion Model
abstract: arXiv:2410.13925v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: \textit{Nature is infinitely resolution-free}. In the context of this reality, existing diffusion models, such as Diffusion Transformers, often face challenges when processing image resolutions outside of their trained domain. To address this limitation, we conceptualize images as sequences of tokens with dynamic sizes, rather than traditional methods that perceive images as fixed-resolution grids. This perspective enables a flexible training strategy that seamlessly accommodates various aspect ratios during both training and inference, thus promoting resolution generalization and eliminating biases introduced by image cropping. On this basis, we present the \textbf{Flexible Vision Transformer} (FiT), a transformer architecture specifically designed for generating images with \textit{unrestricted resolutions and aspect ratios}. translated_title: FiTv2：面向扩散模型的可扩展且改进的灵活视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: “自然是无限无分辨率的”。在这一现实背景下，现有的扩散模型（如Diffusion Transformers）在处理超出其训练域的图像分辨率时常常面临挑战。为了解决这一局限性，我们将图像概念化为具有动态大小的token序列，而不是传统上将图像视为固定分辨率网格的方法。这一视角使得灵活的训练策略能够无缝适应训练和推理过程中的各种宽高比，从而促进分辨率泛化并消除图像裁剪引入的偏差。在此基础上，我们提出了灵活视觉Transformer（FiT），这是一种专门设计用于生成具有无限制分辨率和宽高比图像的Transformer架构。我们进一步将FiT升级为FiTv2，引入了多项创新设计，包括Query-Key向量归一化等。
tldr: 提出了FiTv2架构，通过将图像视为动态大小的token序列而非固定分辨率网格，使扩散模型能够生成无限制分辨率和宽高比的图像。
en_tdlr: FiTv2 is a flexible vision transformer that treats images as token sequences with dynamic sizes, enabling diffusion models to generate images with unrestricted resolutions and aspect ratios.
